text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Rows: the 8 Primary substations; columns: Monday-start weeks from September 2019. A half-hour is usable when it is daylight (sun more than 15 degrees above the horizon), has power and temperature, and lies outside a logged closure. A week is unobserved (dark grey) with fewer than 3 days of 10 or more usable half-hours. White cells precede a Primary's first observed week.'
